clause: §7.2 If Monthly Uptime falls below 99.9%, Customer is eligible for a Service Credit of 10% of that month's fees (30% below 99.0%; 100% below 95.0%). Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the end of the affected month.

Schedule B. Uptime commitment of 99.9% per calendar month. Credits: 10% of the monthly fee below 99.9%, 25% below 99.5%, 50% below 99.0%. Customer must request credits within 30 days after the end of the month.
Section 4. Monthly availability target 99.9%. Below target: 10% credit; below 99.5%: 25% credit. Requests must be made within 30 days after month end.
Uptime commitment 99.9% per quarter-month. Below commitment: 10% service credit; below 99.0%: 25%. Claims within 30 days of month end.
The Plus plan carries no uptime commitment or service credits.
